To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the pig's POA displays a very low density of CART immunoreactive cell bodies and rich immunoreactive fibers; CART immunoreactive fibers do not co-expressed any of the substances studied, but a small percentage of fibers co-express SOM, CCK and SP.
CART is present in cell bodies in the MPA and the periventral region of the PO, and in fibers in the MPA, the PPN, the LPA and the MPN.
CART is present in the POA of the domestic pig, where it is mainly expressed in the periventicular region, and it co-exists with GnRH, but not with other neuropeptides.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the distribution and chemical coding pattern in the pig POA.
CART distribution and the co-expression of CART with other neuropeptides in the POA.
the distribution and co-expression pattern of CART and other neurotransmitter/neuromodulator systems in the pig POA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CART is widely distributed in the POA, and that CART-IR cells and fibers do not contain GnRH and SP, but a small number of CART-IR neurons also express SOM, CCK and SP.
CART is present in a few cell bodies and in a high concentration of fibers in the POA of the pig, and that CART-IR fibers may be co-localized with SOM, CCK, and SP, but not with NPY or GnRH.
CART-IR fibers and cells are present in the POA, and CART may influence GnRHa secretion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the POA is a site of CART production and a target of CART.
the POA is a region rich in CART-IR fibers and a low number of CART-IR cells, and CART-IR fibers are in close proximity with GnRH neurons.
the CART distribution pattern in the pig's POA is similar to that of other mammalian species.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CART is present in the POA, and it may influence gonadotropins secretion through its action on GnRH neurons.
the pig POA displays a rich immunoreactivity of CART in fibers, and a low density of CART-IR cell body.
CART is expressed in the POA and is likely to play a role in the regulation of GnRH neurons.
